title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery: When the Storage Clock Starts for Reinstatement Expense Payments
content:
Storage lot intake convention for the reinstatement expense payment on a Repossession and Collateral Recovery case. The end date is the last day of the storage the payment covers.

**Rule.** For the reinstatement expense payment, where the recovery method is impound release, the storage clock starts the day after the posting date of the latest impound lot charges expense on the case, or the day after the recovery date where none is posted; where the recovery method is not impound release and the recovery date fell on a Saturday or a Sunday, the storage clock starts the day after the following Monday, that is 2 days later for a Saturday and 1 day later for a Sunday than the day after the recovery date; otherwise the storage clock starts the day after the recovery date; the days held are counted from the day the storage clock starts through the end date.

Weekdays follow the ordinary calendar (5 January 2026 is a Monday).

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical dates)

| Recovery method | Recovery date | Impound lot charges posted | Storage clock starts | Days held through an end date of 20 January 2026 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| involuntary recovery | Thursday 8 January 2026 | — | Friday 9 January | 12 |
| voluntary surrender | Saturday 10 January 2026 | — | Tuesday 13 January | 8 |
| involuntary recovery | Sunday 11 January 2026 | — | Tuesday 13 January | 8 |
| impound release | Thursday 8 January 2026 | latest posted 14 January | Thursday 15 January | 6 |
| impound release | Thursday 8 January 2026 | none posted | Friday 9 January | 12 |

For an impound release the weekday of the recovery date plays no part.
